$comment: Mock2 inventory — Atelier, extracted from docs/reference/atelier-prototype.html (behavioral authority). Every screen, its fields, actions, and states, including empty states. Verified against a full Playwright walkthrough on 2026-07-31 (22/22 checks passed).
product: Atelier — the client-work operating system for a small creative studio

pipeline.note: Each stage has exactly one owning screen; the numbered stage rail (01–08, checkmarks on completed stages) is the project navigation.

screens.purpose: Studio at a glance: revenue, workload, project health — all computed from real data.
states: burn empty (no active projects) → empty state with 'Open pipeline' action

emptyState.burn: No active projects / Burn appears once projects are in flight. → Open pipeline

screens.purpose: Eight-column board: every engagement from inquiry to report. Inquiry column shows unconverted leads; other columns show projects at that stage.
fields: lead cards (name, contact, budget chip, age)
project cards (name, client, budget, first teammate avatar)
actions: new project (modal: name, client, budget USD, starting stage brief..proposal)

emptyState.perColumn: Nothing in <stage>; inquiry column adds '— share your intake link' + 'Get the link' button

screens.purpose: Inquiries inbox — submissions from intake forms, convertible to projects.
actions: convert → creates client if new, creates project at brief stage with budget mapped from range, seeds a Brief doc from the answers, links lead.projectId

emptyState.list: No inquiries yet / Publish an intake form and share the link. → Open form builder

screens.purpose: Intake forms list.

emptyState.list: No intake forms yet / Build your first inquiry form. → Create a form

screens.purpose: Three-pane builder: palette (drag-in field types), form canvas, field settings.
fields: ordered fields: type ∈ {text, longtext, choice, budget, date, file}, label, required, options (choice/budget)
actions: drag palette item into form (drop position honored) or click to append
states: field selected vs none (settings pane empty state)

emptyState.form: An empty form / Drag your first field in from the palette. → Add short text
emptyState.settings: Select a field / Choose any field to edit its prompt and rules.

screens.purpose: The public intake form a visitor submits.
fields: per form definition: short text, long text, choice select, budget pill group (single-select), date, file upload box
actions: fill + Send inquiry → validates required fields (toast names first missing), creates lead status=new with all answers attached, fires form_submitted automations, redirects to leads (studio preview)

screens.purpose: Studio-wide reusable assets and collections.
fields: collection cards: cover, name, asset count

emptyState.grid: Nothing collected yet / Images from project deliveries gather here automatically. → Open a project

screens.purpose: Master-detail: flow list + visual node editor. Typed nodes; flows run live off real events.
fields: flow list (name, run count, trigger label, enable switch)
canvas nodes: trigger {form_submitted, proposal_signed, deliverable_approved, date_reached}, condition, action {create_project, seed_tasks, send_email, move_stage, post_reminder}
actions: connect via out-port then target (triggers cannot be targets)
test run (synthetic context, only this flow)

emptyState.list: No flows yet / Wire a trigger to actions. → Create a flow
emptyState.canvas: Empty flow / Add a trigger, then chain actions after it. → Add node
emptyState.detail: Pick a flow / Select a flow on the left, or create one.

screens.purpose: Rate card and studio defaults; every estimate's margin computes from here.
fields: rate card rows: role, bill rate/h, cost/h, computed margin chip (warn <40%)

screens.purpose: Project hub under the stage rail: stats, pipeline dots, recent activity.
actions: Go to <owning screen of current stage>

emptyState.activity: Quiet so far / Activity from documents, estimates and production will appear here. → Open production

screens.purpose: Stage 01 — the original submission, kept whole; every answer stays attached to the lead that created the project.
fields: client-of-record card when no linked lead

emptyState.noLead: No linked inquiry / Next time, share the public intake form. → See inquiries

screens.purpose: Stage 02 — living documents (Brief, Direction, SOW) with share states.
fields: visibility chip (Private / Team / Shared with client — client tone is amber dashed)

emptyState.list: No documents yet / Start with the brief — it feeds the proposal later. → Write the brief

screens.purpose: Block editor.
fields: blocks: p, h1, h2, li, callout, quote, img (src+caption), divider
actions: type '/' → slash menu (filterable) turns block into any type
Enter splits → new block (li continues li)
text selection → floating micro-toolbar (bold, italic, strike, comment-on-selection)
share menu private/team/client (client = portal read-only, comments on)

emptyState.blocks: placeholders per block type, e.g. 'Write, or type / for blocks…'

screens.purpose: Stage 03 — pan/zoom infinite canvas for moodboards; client-visible boards accept comments, never edits.
fields: items: image (from file library), sticky note (editable), text card (kicker + serif text + swatches), frame (labeled)
comment pins (amber = client author, cobalt = team)
actions: scroll pans; ⌘/ctrl+scroll zooms at cursor; shift/middle-drag or touch pans
drag moves whole selection (connectors follow live)
add image from project file library or sample upload

emptyState.noBoards: No boards yet / A pan-and-zoom canvas for moodboards. → Create a board
emptyState.blankCanvas: A blank canvas / Drop in a note, an image or a frame from the toolbar.

screens.purpose: Stage 04 — spreadsheet grid priced from the rate card; live margin vs studio target.
fields: grid columns: row #, phase (select of 4), role (select from rate card), description, rate (auto-set from card on role change, editable), hours, computed subtotal, comment + delete
summary rail: fees, 5% contingency, internal cost, total, margin bar vs target, healthy/below-target note, per-phase subtotals + %
actions: select numeric cell → drag-fill handle fills value down
role change re-prices from rate card (toast)
states: locked (signed proposal — inputs render read-only, lock banner shows signed rev)

emptyState.noEstimate: No estimate yet / Line items price from your rate card. → Start the estimate
emptyState.emptySheet: Empty sheet / Add the first line item to start pricing. → Add line

screens.purpose: Stage 05 — print-faithful warm-paper pages assembled live from brief + board + estimate; e-signature; signed revisions immutable.
fields: status chip (Draft rev n / Sent — awaiting signature / Signed · rev n locked)
page outline rail with jump links

pages: cover (eyebrow, h1, cover note, footer meta), contents (dotted-leader TOC), brief excerpt, selected direction (board images + note quotes), investment (grouped-by-phase table + total), terms & signature (sigbox: drawn image or typed script + timestamps)
actions: assemble proposal (defaults: project brief doc, first board, estimate)
edit sections modal (cover note, brief doc, board, terms)
send for signature (audit row, stage → proposal if earlier)
states: signed (immutable; sections locked; audit shows full history)

emptyState.none: No proposal yet / Assemble brief excerpts, a board and the estimate. → Assemble proposal

screens.purpose: Stage 06 — kanban + zoomable timeline + week/month calendar over ONE task store (R1).
fields: view segmented control + 'All views synced — one task store' note + active count
kanban: 4 columns (To do / In progress / In review / Done), cards with phase dot chip, due (overdue flag), checklist progress, comments, assignee

timeline: phase group rows with translucent phase bars, task bars colored by phase (done = faded), dependency bezier arrows, cobalt today line, sticky labels, zoom 8–60 px/day (weekly ticks when zoomed out)
calendar: month (6 weeks) or week mode, mini-month rail + legend, entries: task due (cobalt), booking (teal, multi-day), meeting (violet), milestone (◆ bold)
actions: drag card between columns (status changes, toast confirms other views updated)
drag timeline bar → shift start+due by day delta
drag across calendar cells → new entry modal (title, type, who, from/to)
click task anywhere → task modal (title, status, phase, assignee, start, due, single dependency, checklist add/toggle, delete)

emptyState.noTasks: No tasks yet / Seed a task set from the studio template. → Seed template tasks
emptyState.timeline: Nothing scheduled / Give tasks start and due dates. → Open a task
emptyState.calendar: An open calendar / Drag across a few days to create the first booking. → Add an event

screens.purpose: Stage 07 — folder tree, versioned files, share-to-portal, client approvals.
fields: tree: All files (count), Shared to portal, folders, storage meter
file rows: kind thumb (image preview), name, version badge (opens history), size/uploader/age, approval chip (Approved by client / Changes requested + note / Awaiting client)
actions: new version (+vN; a 'changes' file returns to pending, toast)
share/unshare to portal (share sets approval=pending; unshare clears)
states: file.approval: null → pending → approved | changes (changes + new version → pending)

emptyState.none: Nothing here yet / Upload the first deliverable. → Upload file
emptyState.search: No matches / Nothing named '<q>' in this view. → Clear search

screens.purpose: Stage 08 — close the loop: print-styled account of billed vs budget, margin vs target, approvals, tasks closed, shipped list, client quote.
fields: paper page: stats strip (billed, margin, deliverables approved %, tasks closed), numbered sections (outcome, what shipped, client's words)
contents rail with readiness checks (n of 6 sections ready)
states: sections conditionally ready based on real data

screens.purpose: Client landing: serif welcome, 'Needs you' action list, per-project stage strips, recent conversation.
fields: welcome headline varies by pending work
action items: sign proposal (rev, sent age), review file (vN)
project cards with 8-dot stage strip + task progress

emptyState.noShares: Nothing here yet / When the studio shares briefs, boards or files with you, they appear here.
emptyState.allClear: All clear / We'll nudge you here when something needs a signature or an approval.

screens.purpose: Only docs with share=client; read-only reader with per-block comment buttons.
fields: reader renders all block types read-only
actions: comment on doc or any block

emptyState.list: No documents shared yet / Your brief and creative direction will appear here once the studio shares them.

screens.purpose: Only boards with share=client; full canvas in read-only comment-only mode ('View & comment — the studio edits').

emptyState.list: No boards shared yet / Moodboards and direction boards land here when the studio opens them up.

screens.purpose: Sent/signed proposals only (never drafts); the signing surface.
fields: status banner (awaiting signature rev n / signed n ago, locked)
sign modal: legal name input, live typed-script preview, drawn signature canvas (pointer), clear
actions: review & sign → typed (required) + drawn (optional) → locks revision, locks estimate, stage → production, 2 audit rows, proposal_signed automations fire

emptyState.none: No proposal yet / When a proposal is ready for you, it appears here to review and sign.

screens.purpose: Shared deliverables: preview + detail; Approve / Needs changes (R4).
fields: detail rail: status chip (Ready for your review / Approved by you / In rework), version, uploaded, size, file comment threads
footnote: 'Needs changes lands on the studio's production board as a task'
actions: approve → deliverable_approved automations fire, studio notified
needs changes → note modal → file.approval=changes + production task created carrying the note, assigned to the file's last uploader + file comment thread added

emptyState.list: No deliverables shared yet / Files the studio shares for your review will collect here, with versions.

screens.purpose: All threads the client may see (shared surfaces only), open + resolved.
fields: threads with anchor labels, client badge on client authors

emptyState.list: No open threads / Comment on any brief, board or deliverable — the studio sees it instantly, badged as yours.

crossCutting.purpose: Anchored comment threads everywhere + per-screen presence.
fields: comment button shows unresolved count; amber '· client' flag when a client participates
drawer: scoped to current anchor or project or all; open + resolved groups
thread: anchor label pill, resolve/reopen, replies, @mentions highlighted
presence avatar stack with green dots in topbar
actions: select doc text → comment on selection
crossCutting.clientScoping: Clients see threads only on shared surfaces: client-shared docs/blocks, client-shared boards/items, shared files, non-draft proposals.

emptyState.drawer: No open comments / Select text in a doc, a board item, an estimate row or a file and start a thread.

crossCutting.purpose: Studio chrome: sidebar (nav + active projects + persona footer), topbar (breadcrumb + stage chip, ⌘K search, presence, notifications bell, Client view, comments toggle).
actions: Client view → switch to this project's client persona

stateTransitions.lead.status: new → contacted → converted (converted is terminal; sets projectId)
stateTransitions.project.stage: inquiry → brief → concept → estimate → proposal → production → delivery → report (send proposal fast-forwards to proposal; signing sets production; move_stage automation may set any)
stateTransitions.proposal.status: draft → sent → signed (signed is terminal; revision frozen)
stateTransitions.estimate.locked: false → true when linked proposal signs (no unlock path)
stateTransitions.file.approval: null → pending (on share) → approved | changes; changes → pending (on new version); unshare → null
stateTransitions.task.status: todo ↔ doing ↔ review ↔ done (free movement via any of the three views)
stateTransitions.doc.share / board.share: private ↔ team ↔ client (client exposes to portal, read-only/comment-only)
